run_gen_gtest_pred_impl: run gen_gtest_pred_impl.py with MAX_ARITY argument to generate gtest predicate assertion header and unit test files
generate_header: generate the gtest_pred_impl.h header file with predicate assertion macros up to the given arity
generate_unittest: generate the gtest_pred_impl_unittest.cc unit test file with tests for predicate assertions up to the given arity
review_implementation_for_arity: review the ImplementationForArity function that generates C++ template helper functions and macro definitions for n-ary predicates
review_tests_for_arity: review the TestsForArity function that generates 64 test combinations for each arity level covering functions, functors, and user types
